cli.tool: vercel-labs skills CLI (npm package `skills`), run through npx
cli.verified: skills 1.7.2 on 2026-10-14 (help and README). It declares node >=22.20.0; older Node 22 prints an EBADENGINE warning.
cli.policy: The kit ships only its own skills. Every third-party skill is external: installed and updated on each machine from its upstream, never vendored. The project CLAUDE.md rules win over any of them.

skills.name: accessibility
skills.purpose: WCAG 2.2 audit and fixes: names, contrast, focus, keyboard, live regions, forms.
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add addyosmani/web-quality-skills --skill accessibility -g -a claude-code -y
skills.note: CLAUDE.md wins: its plain-HTML examples (raw

skills.name: seo
skills.purpose: Technical and on-page SEO: meta tags, canonical, robots, sitemap, JSON-LD, hreflang.
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add AgriciDaniel/claude-seo --skill seo -g -a claude-code -y
skills.note: The user's installed seo skill (comprehensive audits: technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, schema, E-E-A-T). Chosen over addyosmani/web-quality-skills' seo to avoid a name clash in ~/.claude/skills/seo. Kit rule WA6 wins on conflict.

skills.name: tailwind-design-system
skills.purpose: Tailwind v4 design systems: @theme tokens, token hierarchy, component variants, responsive and dark mode patterns.
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add wshobson/agents --skill tailwind-design-system -g -a claude-code -y
skills.note: CLAUDE.md wins: components are HeroUI v3 through wrappers (WA8, W7), not Radix Slot + CVA; the theme is not a React Context with localStorage (WA3 stores, W3, WA4 re-applies the theme on astro:after-swap).

skills.name: tailwind-v4-best-practices
skills.purpose: Tailwind CSS v4 code: @theme configuration, semantic utilities, OKLCH tokens, v3 to v4 migration.
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add jenishshrestha/ai-skills --skill tailwind-v4-best-practices -g -a claude-code -y
skills.note: No license: cannot be vendored, install it from upstream.

skills.name: zustand
skills.purpose: Zustand stores: state shape, actions, slices, selectors.
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add lobehub/lobehub --skill zustand -g -a claude-code -y
skills.license: LobeHub Community License (Apache-2.0 plus conditions; derivative works need a commercial license)
skills.note: It describes LobeHub's own store conventions; the store patterns of kit-astro:astro-setup and WA3 win. The install clones the whole lobehub repository, so it is slow.

skills.name: turborepo-monorepo
skills.purpose: Turborepo workspaces: turbo.json tasks, caching, filters, CI pipelines for apps/* monorepos.
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add giuseppe-trisciuoglio/developer-kit --skill turborepo-monorepo -g -a claude-code -y
skills.note: Offer it only when the repository is (or will be) a Turborepo monorepo. CLAUDE.md wins: its NestJS reference sets up Jest; the kit uses Vitest (AN13, testRunner).

skills.name: impeccable
skills.purpose: Distinctive, production-grade UI: design context, typography, color, layout, motion, critique and polish commands.
skills.path: .agents/skills/impeccable (one build per harness; the CLI picks one)
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add pbakaus/impeccable --skill impeccable -g -a claude-code -y
skills.license: Apache-2.0 (NOTICE: builds on Anthropic's frontend-design skill)
skills.note: Upstream's own installer (`npx impeccable install --providers=claude --scope=global`, update `npx impeccable update`) also adds hooks to the current project; the skills CLI command only installs the skill. Copies made by hand (not in ~/.agents/.skill-lock.json) are not updated: run install once so update can track it. Brand values live in kit.json `brand` (docs/brand.md), not in a CLAUDE.md design-context section.

skills.name: emil-design-eng
skills.purpose: Emil Kowalski's design engineering: UI polish, component feel, animation decisions, easing and timing.
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add emilkowalski/skills --skill emil-design-eng -g -a claude-code -y
skills.note: Copies made by hand are not updated: run install once so update can track it.

skills.name: design-taste-frontend
skills.purpose: taste-skill v2: art direction and an anti-slop house style for public web pages (landing, marketing, portfolio), with a browser-based inspector.
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add Leonxlnx/taste-skill --skill design-taste-frontend -g -a claude-code -y
skills.note: Known by its folder name taste-skill. v2 (2026-10-11) is for public pages, not app screens; its scripts need Node 22+ and Chrome, Edge or Chromium and write to .taste-skill/. A hand-made copy under its folder name (~/.claude/skills/taste-skill) declares the same skill name: remove it after installing. CLAUDE.md wins: its token sheet goes into the single global CSS @theme (W8, WA9), not a second stylesheet.

skills.name: design-tokens
skills.purpose: Generate a token set from an aesthetic direction: semantic colors for light and dark, spacing, type ramp, radii, shadows, motion.
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add julianoczkowski/designer-skills --skill design-tokens -g -a claude-code -y
skills.note: CLAUDE.md wins: Tailwind v4 tokens live in the global CSS @theme, never in tailwind.config (WA9). It refers to sibling skills of its repo (design-brief, frontend-design) that the kit does not require.

skills.name: expo-router
skills.purpose: Expo Router: file-based routes, layouts, native stacks and tabs, modals and form sheets, headers, search.
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add expo/skills --skill expo-router -g -a claude-code -y

skills.name: expo-react-native-performance
skills.purpose: Expo / React Native performance: lists, images, re-renders, animations, memory, startup.
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add pproenca/dot-skills --skill expo-react-native-performance -g -a claude-code -y
skills.note: CLAUDE.md wins: server state and caching stay in TanStack Query (M2), lists follow ME8.

skills.name: prisma-nestjs-patterns
skills.purpose: Prisma with NestJS: PrismaService, atomic transactions and SELECT FOR UPDATE, repositories, N+1 and pagination, seeds, hand-written Prisma stubs.
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add davidcastagnetoa/skills --skill prisma-nestjs-patterns -g -a claude-code -y
skills.note: No license: cannot be vendored. Written in Spanish. kit-nestjs:nestjs-prisma and the AN rules win where they differ. Update overwrites local edits to the installed copy.

skills.name: nestjs-clean-typescript
skills.purpose: Clean NestJS with TypeScript: SOLID, modular architecture, testing.
skills.install: npx --yes skills@latest add mindrally/skills --skill nestjs-clean-typescript -g -a claude-code -y
skills.note: Optional: superseded by kit-nestjs:nestjs-prisma. Upstream is a short generic guide. Update overwrites local edits to the installed copy.
